age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 45 years Age relaxation will be as per government rules. | Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

qualification.details: Para Pump Operator: Matriculation (10th) with a certificate in trade of Electrician/Wireman/ Diesel Mechanic/ Pump Mechanic/ Motor Mechanic/ Pump Operator cum Mechanic from a recognized ITI OR Matriculation (10th) with a certificate in the above-cited trades under the skill development scheme of the Government. Experience in the related field of IPH/HPPWD/CPPWD/PSUs/ an outsourcing agency providing service in H.P. Jal Shakti Vibhag. Para Fitter: Matriculation (10th) with an ITI certificate in the trade of Fitter/Plumber from a recognized ITI/Institute OR Matriculation (10th) with a certificate in the above-cited trade under the skill development scheme of the Government. Experience in the related field of IPH/HPPWD/CPPWD/PSUs/ an outsourcing agency providing service in H.P. Jal Shakti Vibhag. Multipurpose Worker: Middle (8th) pass and its equivalent from a school duly recognized by the State Government or Central Government. Experience in the related field of JSV/HPPWD/CPWD/PSUs/ OR Outsourcing agency providing services in HP Jal Shakti Vibhag. Para Cook: Matriculation examination from a School/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh. The condition of passing 10th from Himachali School shall not be applicable to Bonafide Himachali. The candidate must possess a degree/diploma in any trade from a Government-approved Hotel Management Institute/Institute of Hotel Management or Food Production Institute or have a minimum of 5 years of experience in cooking/catering from any Government or private institution. No family member of the candidate should be in any kind of Government/PSU/Board job. Para Helper: Matriculation examination from the Board/University recognized by the H.P. Central Government. No family member of the candidate should be in any kind of Government/PSU/Board job. Experience in the related field.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs.9000/-PM for Para Cook, Rs.5500/-PM for Para Helper, Rs. 7100/-PM for Para Pump Operator, Rs. 7100/-PM for Para Fitter, Rs. 6000/-PM for Multipurpose Worker

selection_process: Skill/Physical Test Written Examination (for Multipurpose Worker) Evaluation based on marks obtained

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag Recruitment 2026 is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies announced for various posts including Para Pump Operator, Para Fitter, Multipurpose Worker, Para Cook, and Para Helper.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Multipurpose Worker post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Multipurpose Worker post is Middle (8th) pass from a recognized school.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Para Pump Operator post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Para Pump Operator post is between 18 to 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Para Cook post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Para Cook post is Rs. 9000/- PM.

faq.question: Q7. Does the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag offer any age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation will be provided as per the government rules and regulations for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be obtained from the office of the Assistant Engineer, Jal Shakti Sub-Division, Anni, Showad, Dalash, Nither & Nirmand, or downloaded from the departmental website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Skill/Physical Test, Written Examination (for Multipurpose Worker), and evaluation based on marks, experience, and category.
